verses.text: Five days later, the high priest Ananias came down with some elders and a lawyer named Tertullus. They presented their case against Paul to the governor. ⚖️
Paul was called in, and Tertullus began accusing him: “Governor Felix, because of your leadership this nation enjoys much peace, and your wise decisions keep making life better. 👑
“We welcome this in every way and everywhere, most excellent Felix, with deep gratitude. 🙏
“But I do not want to take up too much of your time. Please hear us out briefly. ⏳
“We have found this man to be a public menace, stirring up riots among Jews everywhere and leading the Nazarene sect. ⚠️
“He even tried to defile the temple, so we arrested him. 🏛️
“If you examine him yourself, you can confirm all the things we are accusing him of.” 🔎
The other Jews joined in, claiming these charges were true. 🗣️
The governor nodded for Paul to speak. Paul answered, “I know you have judged this nation for many years, so I am glad to defend myself before you. 🙋
“You can check that I arrived in Jerusalem no more than twelve days ago to worship. 📆
“They did not find me arguing with anyone or stirring up a crowd in the temple, the synagogues, or anywhere in the city. 🏛️
“And they cannot prove the things they are accusing me of now. ⚖️
“But I admit this: I worship the God of our ancestors according to the Way they call a sect. I believe everything written in the Law and the Prophets. 📖
“I share the same hope in God that these men have: that the dead—both the righteous and the unrighteous—will rise again. 🌅
“That is why I work hard to keep my conscience clear before God and people at all times. 💛
“After several years away, I returned to bring gifts for the poor among my people and offerings. 🎁
“I was purified in the temple when some Jews from Asia found me. There was no crowd and no disturbance. 🕊️
“Those men should be here in court to accuse me if they have anything against me. 👀
“Or these people here can say what wrong they found when I stood before the council. ⚖️
“Unless it was about one thing I shouted: ‘I am on trial before you today because I believe the dead will rise!’” 📣
Felix knew the Way fairly well, so he postponed the hearing. “I will decide your case when Commander Lysias arrives,” he said. ⏳
He ordered the centurion to keep Paul under guard but give him some freedom and not stop his friends from caring for or visiting him. 🔓
A few days later, Felix came with his Jewish wife Drusilla. He sent for Paul and listened as Paul spoke about faith in Christ Jesus. 🗣️
As Paul talked about doing what is right, self-control, and the coming judgment, Felix became afraid. “That is enough for now. Go. I will call for you when it is convenient.” 😨
Felix also hoped Paul would offer him money for a release. So he sent for Paul often and talked with him. 🪙
After two years, Porcius Festus took Felix’s place. Wanting to gain favor with the Jews, Felix left Paul in prison. ⛓️
